name: Mocha Oat Milk Latte
caffeineNote: Brand states 80 mg from organic fair trade coffee
summary: Cold brew mocha on organic oat milk with an adaptogenic blend of ashwagandha and maca, sweetened with dates alone and so 0 g added sugar. 80 mg of caffeine and 2 g of protein per 8 oz can at 100 calories. Pop & Bottle publishes no total-sugar figure for this one — only an “around 8 g” for the line — so that column stays blank.
